audit: DYK No. 01 'Time, Compressed' — independent broadcast QA v2 (read-only)
method: All 48 sheets (574 tiles, tile N:SS ≈ N:SS+0.47 s) reviewed in order against timeline-by-second.txt.
Exact word/SFX/cut times recomputed from build_final.py (VO_AT, CUES, START) to 0.01 s; cue keys checked in the dyk-01 *.tsx sources.
Title-safe margins measured numerically on all 574 single frames (bright pixels within 24 px L/R, 14 px T/B).
ship_verdict: Not yet: no CRITICAL/HIGH, but 4 MEDIUM open (V2-M1..M4).
not_verified: Sub-second events between 1-fps samples (flashes, HUD year roll, 9:19 scribble, exact strike timings).
Audio by ear: loudness, ducking, SFX timbre/level, A/V sync drift (SFX timing only checked against the cue list, not the rendered mix).
1080p fine detail: small mono labels and source lines were read at 480 px; typos in tiny text cannot be fully excluded.

findings.what_you_see: Timeline + seven person icons sit unchanged for ~4.5 s (1:07.5→1:12). The 'IN EACH ONE you wake up as someone else' chip only appears after 1:11.5 (tile 1:11 empty, 1:12 shows it).
findings.what_you_hear: 'In each one,' starts 70.15 s; chip keyed to 'someone' (MEAS = C.at('someone') = 71.99 s).
findings.why_its_wrong: The chip states 'In each one' 1.8 s after those words are spoken (>1.5 s late rule) and the frame before it is a >4 s still hold.
findings.suggested_fix: In TcPromise.tsx set MEAS = C.at('In') (or 'each') - 4 so the chip rises on 70.0 s; keep the ui-click-soft but move it in build_final.py to 'In'.

findings.what_you_see: The 1500 Day Clock (ring + 7-row legend) is fully built by 1:35.5 and stays visually unchanged for ~6 s until the village cut at 1:42. Only a faint 'hot' pulse on the 00–01 segment (hotAt = PRAYED-10) is visible; the right half beyond the legend is empty.
findings.what_you_hear: '…references to a first sleep and a second sleep. In between, people prayed, talked, even visited neighbours.' (owl-hoot 1:39).
findings.why_its_wrong: Still hold >4 s while the narration names three distinct beats (first sleep / second sleep / prayed-talked-visited) that are never individually shown.
findings.suggested_fix: Highlight legend rows on their words: 'First sleep' on C.at('first') (~96 s), 'Second sleep' on C.at('second'), the gold 'Awake in the dark' row + segment pulse on 'prayed'/'talked'/'visited' (3 soft ticks). Alternatively build the legend row-by-row on those words instead of all at once on 'Historians'.

findings.what_you_see: 'One lifetime now holds more change than whole centuries once did.' is a single line spanning x = 16…462 px of 480 (measured on frames f0346–f0351): 16 px left / 18 px right margin.
findings.what_you_hear: 'One lifetime now holds more change than whole centuries once did.' (5:44–5:47).
findings.why_its_wrong: Text outside title-safe (rule ≥24 px of 480 L/R, i.e. ≥96 px at 1080p; actual ≈64 px). Risks clipping on overscan displays and looks crammed against the frame edge.
findings.suggested_fix: In Tc1900.tsx reduce that line's fontSize (~15%) or set maxWidth ≈ 1600 px with textAlign center so it wraps to two lines.

findings.what_you_see: Phone body holds ~3 s (good, no header collision any more), but its 5 notification rows are panel2-on-panel and almost invisible (f0366), and the red '12' badge only lands on 'phone' (365.57 s) and is faded/covered by the DYK card at DID-2…DID+8 (≈366.3–366.6 s): visible ≈0.75 s.
findings.what_you_hear: Three pop-reveals at 6:04.84 / 6:05.19 / 6:05.54, then ui-toggle-on 6:06.12 for the DYK card.
findings.why_its_wrong: Badge is a flash element (<1 s then covered) and the three pops have no clearly visible reason (rows barely distinguishable from the phone body). Residual of old H4.
findings.suggested_fix: In Tc2000.tsx give the rows a visible fill (e.g. DL.border/lighter panel + a coloured dot each) so each pop shows a row; land the badge on C.at('checked') (~365.2) and delay the DYK card / phone fade by ~8 frames so the badge holds ≥1 s.

findings.what_you_see: After the Day Clock fades, only the small '1870 · MOST INDUSTRIAL COUNTRIES' label and an empty bar track are on screen for ~3 s; the bar/counter starts at ~6:17.
findings.what_you_hear: 'In eighteen seventy, workers in most industrial countries put in more than three thousand hours a year.'
findings.why_its_wrong: Near-empty ≥1.5 s while narration continues (was part of old L2 at 6:13.5).
findings.suggested_fix: Start the 1870 bar counting on C.at('seventy') (Y1870) instead of THREE, or show a big '1870' numeral in the empty area until the bar runs.

findings.what_you_see: Still holds >4 s: church-bell + life-expectancy cards (~5 s); Saint Monday DYK card (~7 s); Beard book alone on the left half, right half empty (~5 s, subtitle at 4:49 only); Ford DYK card (~8 s); 300 million card + network (~5 s).
findings.what_you_hear: Narration continues on-topic in each case (e.g. 'lowered by the many children who never grow up', 'Henry Ford more than doubled… eight hours?').
findings.why_its_wrong: Violates the 'no still hold >4 s' rule; the DYK cards are read-along text so impact is low.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one keyed micro-beat per hold: '≈35' counter tick on 'thirty five'; underline 'took Mondays off' on 'Mondays'; 'nervous exhaustion' stamp on the book at C.at('exhaustion'); highlight '$5' / 'eight hours' in the Ford card on their words; pulse '300 million' or add a jobs icon row on 'jobs'.

findings.what_you_see: Full headline lines appear at the start of their sentence: 'Every century fit more into an hour.' (visible 7:11.47); 'When was the last time you did something for the very first time?' (8:24.47); 'The Sun you see in the sky is not the Sun as it is right now.' (9:13.47).
findings.what_you_hear: 'more into an hour' 7:13.03–7:13.72; 'very first time' 8:25.95–8:26.66; 'not the Sun as it is right now' 9:13.83–9:15.40.
findings.why_its_wrong: Key words/twists are readable 1.3–2 s before they are spoken (the next-episode twist most noticeably).
findings.suggested_fix: Reveal the gold/italic tail on its word: e.g. in TcOutro render 'not the Sun as it is right now.' with opacity ease(f, C.at('not')-4, C.at('not')+6); same for 'more into an hour.' (C.at('more')) and 'very first time?' (C.at('very')).

findings.what_you_see: The scene dims on 'one man' (piano 5:05.30) but the cliffhanger band 'Next: one man turns half a day of work' only appears on 'work' (WORK, 5:06.59), ~1.5 s later; 1.3 s of dimmed, unchanged frame.
findings.what_you_hear: 'And in the next century, one man would turn half a day of work into ninety three minutes.'
findings.why_its_wrong: Band text ~1.5 s behind the phrase it states; dead dimmed beat.
findings.suggested_fix: In Tc1800.tsx key the first Cliffhanger part to MAN (C.at('man')) instead of WORK.

findings.shot: TcIntro, TcPromise, Tc1500, Tc1700, Tc1800, TcReveal, TcOutro
findings.what_you_see: Cascades: 0:26 five cues (whoosh-soft, 3×knock-solid, impact-deep-soft) on the logo words; 7 ui-click-soft over 1:14–1:15 (icons lighting); 7 clicks over 1:33–1:34 with five legend rows appearing in <1 s (1:34.47 shows 6 rows vs 1 at 1:33.47); 6 clicks at 3:22; 5 at 4:25; 7 at 7:03–7:04; 3 cues at 9:19 (whoosh-soft, pencil-scribble, ui-toggle-on).
findings.what_you_hear: As listed (clicks at gain 0.15, so mostly soft).
findings.why_its_wrong: Rule flags 3+ effects in one second; the 1:34 legend is also a rushed second (>3 new elements).
findings.suggested_fix: Thin each click cascade to 2–3 audible ticks per second (or one 'cascade' sample); at 9:19 drop either the whoosh or the toggle; build the 1500 legend over ~2 s (see V2-M2).

findings.what_you_see: When the newspaper fans into a stack ('news becomes a habit'), the back sheets' top edges run into the 'THE FIRST NEWSPAPER' label (f0164: label at y≈50 touches the rotated back sheet at y≈55–60).
findings.suggested_fix: Move the label up ~20 px (1080p ~40 px) or reduce the fan rotation/offset of the back sheets.
